speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The comedy is in the stock, and off the stage. Lent has the doors shut. I am not giving thee a line of it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I did not ask for a line. Thou art talking as if the meadow were a yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Queen paid the company twenty pounds in March. It was fetched and divided. It is not a wage in a bag, and it is not thy rent.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Twenty pounds is a large sentence. Say what came home in thy hand, before I dislike the whole.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: What I have in my hand is this canvas, sewn up again.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: It was sixty shillings when we made it a plan. Weigh it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eighteen shillings, not sixty. Forty-two went out of it yesterday, inside a payment of five pounds for my father.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Say the shops, before I name what the eighteen must do.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The other baker in the High Street, one and forty shillings. The shoemaker, four and forty shillings and sixpence. The whittawer, fourteen shillings and sixpence, for skins. Each page ruled. No word of it at our door.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Your father's shoemaker or ours, Will, it's the one leather.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The five pounds is paid. The belt made up what this canvas did not. I have not told him.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Malt, before the summer price bites. Corn, the same. Shoes, one pair fewer than the sixty would have bought. I am naming the uses before I untie it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Name them. The eighteen is thine. The rest is already gone.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I have named them. Since you are spending words, which mayor stands at the end of a street.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Lord Mayor, at the end of my street in London. He would shut the playhouses if he could. He has never spoken to me. I have not been inside his house.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then he is a neighbour you do not have. Eighteen shillings is what I am holding. Malt, corn, and the one pair fewer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The comedy is not on a stage. The twenty pounds was the company's. I am not adding a house to either sentence.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Do not add one. I have not untied this. I have already given it its work.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou art weighing it sewn. I unpicked it when the belt would not reach, and I sewed it before it came to thy hand.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I felt the sew. I will not be asked to admire a knot after the coin is gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not asking thee to admire it. Eighteen is the true weight. I would rather have brought the sixty.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Rather will not buy malt. Walk as far as the brook, and do not spend the eighteen again in a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: To the brook. One pair fewer. His shoemaker or ours, the same leather. I heard thee.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then you heard the leather, and not only the mayor. That will do until the water.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Until the water. The eighteen stays in thy hand, and I am not spending it again on the way.
